breakdown.description: The prompt uses the no-drop suddenly applied-load result P_max = 2W even though the problem includes a nonzero drop height, which changes the energy balance and the maximum force.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly uses P_max = 2W = 1600 N, which is the suddenly applied-load result that ignores the nonzero drop height h = 150 mm. The ground truth requires solving the full energy conservation equation W(h + δ_max) = P_max²L/(2AE) with h = 150 mm to get the correct (larger) P_max. The agent repeated the original error instead of fixing it.
